posts.title: Track PRs, Issues, and Agents in Copilot CLI Statuslines
posts.description: I built composable Copilot CLI statuslines so you can check PRs, issues, and subagents at a glance, then open GitHub links without searching your session.

posts.title: Make a Copilot Canvas Multiplayer with a GitHub Repo
posts.description: githubStore backs a Copilot canvas with a JSON file in a GitHub repo, so everyone editing the same board sees each other's changes. One file, many writers.

posts.title: Deploy Containers to Azure App Service with azd
posts.description: azd 1.27.0 deploys container images to Azure App Service. Set language: docker with host: appservice and azd builds the image, pushes it to ACR, and updates the site.
